sourceFiles.role: frozen native-action composition matrix and consumer harness
diagnostic action and envelope contract authority

expectation.nonOverlapping: Two independent native edits can be applied against one original document coordinate system.
expectation.overlapping: Any overlapping spans are rejected as a conflict without destructive ordering.
expectation.alternative: Two actions targeting one span are mutually exclusive and are rejected as a conflict.
expectation.originalCoordinate: A length-changing first replacement does not corrupt a later edit because the batch is applied from original coordinates in descending order.
expectation.reanalyzeEach: After the first action, the old second action is stale; a fresh diagnostic action from reanalysis is required.
expectation.repeated: The old captured action is rejected after successful correction rather than silently reapplied.
